description: Answer a person who asked to be linked to a name in your film's credits ("Is this you?"): get_film shows such a credit with status claimed and who is asking (claim). approve links the name to their profile and shows the film on it, exactly like an accepted invite; decline leaves the name as plain text. The person is e-mailed your answer either way. Decide only as the user says, after telling them who is asking. Returns the full credit list.

decision.description: approve = yes, that is them: the name links to their profile and the film shows on it. decline = not them: the name stays plain text.

film_id.description: The film's public id (from list_films / get_film).

name: answer_film_credit_claim
title: Answer a credit claim
